# Business Center ADGM — Aegis Coworking (full)

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM runs a business centre on Level 38 of Addax Tower (Office 3812), Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction. Serviced private offices start from AED 4,500 per month, dedicated desks AED 1,150, flexi desks AED 1,000 and virtual offices from AED 292. ADGM office leases are registered on AccessRP.

Focus: The company setup journey: choosing a workspace, KYC, AccessRP lease registration and using the address for an ADGM licence.

This site (businesscenteradgm.online) is a one-page guide to the Aegis business center in ADGM: serviced and private offices, desks, virtual office, meeting rooms, registered office and ADGM office leasing.

Last Updated: 2026-10-07

## Key facts

- Location: Level 38, Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside ADGM (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Private office (1–20+ people): from AED 4,500 per month; furnished, lockable, 24/7 access, ADGM registered office included
- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month (one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee); ADGM registered office included
- Flexi desk (coworking): AED 1,000 per month; day pass AED 100
- Virtual office: from AED 292 per month (ADGM business address + mail handling)
- Meeting rooms and boardroom: hourly booking
- Leases 12–36 months, registered on AccessRP
- No deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; ADGM government fees separate
- FSRA-regulated firms usually need a private office

- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM; 24/7 access for office and desk members

## What makes a good business center in ADGM?

A good business center in ADGM gives you three things: an address inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction, a lease ADGM will accept for your licence, and a furnished, serviced office you can use from day one. Aegis Coworking's business centre on Level 38 of Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, offers all three — from AED 1,000 a month.

## Services

### Private office — From AED 4,500 / month

A serviced office in ADGM for 1–20+ people: furnished, lockable, 24/7 access and a registered ADGM business address.

### Dedicated desk — AED 1,150 / month

Your own desk with an ADGM registered office address — the lowest-cost office for ADGM licence applications.

### Flexi desk — AED 1,000 / month

A flexi desk in ADGM: any open desk in the coworking space, with WiFi, coffee and the lounge.

### Virtual office — From AED 292 / month

A business address ADGM companies can register, with mail handling and directory listing.

### Meeting room — Hourly booking

A meeting room ADGM clients can visit — book the meeting room or boardroom by the hour.

### Day pass — AED 100 / day

The cheapest way into the business center: a full workday at a desk for AED 100.

### ADGM office lease — Registered on AccessRP

ADGM office leasing done for you — leases of 12–36 months registered on AccessRP.

### Registered office — Included

Every private office and dedicated desk includes an ADGM registered office for your licence.

## Business setup office in five steps

1. Choose your space — Pick a private office, dedicated desk, flexi desk or virtual office that suits your licence and team.
2. Tour or video walkthrough — See Level 38 of Addax Tower Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, or on a WhatsApp video call.
3. KYC & due diligence — Quick compliance checks required by ADGM, handled by our team.
4. Lease registered on AccessRP — We issue your ADGM office lease and register it on AccessRP for your licence application.
5. Licence & move in — Use your ADGM registered office for the licence, collect your access card and start work.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is a business center in ADGM?

A business center in ADGM is a serviced building or floor inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction that rents furnished offices, desks, meeting rooms and registered addresses on flexible terms, with reception, internet and cleaning included. Aegis Coworking runs its business centre on Level 38 of Addax Tower, Al Reem Island.

Read more:

### How much does the business center in ADGM cost?

A serviced private office starts from AED 4,500 per month, a dedicated desk is AED 1,150, a flexi desk AED 1,000, a virtual office from AED 292 per month and a day pass AED 100. Meeting rooms are booked by the hour. ADGM government fees are separate.

Read more:

### Is the business center on Al Reem Island inside ADGM?

Yes. Addax Tower on Al Reem Island is within the ADGM jurisdiction, so the business centre gives you a genuine ADGM business address.

Read more:

### Can I use the business center as my ADGM registered office?

Yes. Private offices and dedicated desks include an ADGM registered office for your licence application and renewals. The virtual office also provides an ADGM business address.

### Do you provide the ADGM office lease?

Yes. We issue your ADGM office lease and register it on AccessRP. Leases run from 12 to 36 months.

Read more:

### What is the cheapest desk space in ADGM?

A day pass at AED 100 is the cheapest option. For monthly use, a flexi desk is AED 1,000, and the dedicated desk at AED 1,150 is the lowest-cost option that includes a registered ADGM address.

Read more:

### Are there deposits or setup fees?

No deposit, no admin fees and no setup fees, with free registration. A one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee applies to the dedicated desk.

### Is the business centre open 24/7?

Private office and dedicated desk members have secure 24/7 access. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM.

### Can I book a meeting room without renting an office?

Yes. Meeting rooms and the boardroom can be booked by the hour for client meetings in ADGM.

Read more:

### Do FSRA-regulated firms need a private office?

FSRA-regulated firms usually need physical premises such as a private office, while many non-regulated companies can use a dedicated desk, flexi desk or virtual office.

Read more:

### Can I start small and upgrade later?

Yes. Start on a flexi desk, dedicated desk or virtual office and move into a private office in the same business centre as you grow.

### How do I book a tour of the business center?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +971 50 392 6316. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, and we can send a video walkthrough if you are abroad.
